paras: Upgrade your Nissan or Infiniti's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake rotor types shown for vehicles fitted with the Akebono rear caliper and 350x20mm rear rotors , including the Nissan 370Z (Z34) and 370Z Nismo , Nissan Z (RZ34) and Z Nismo , Nissan Skyline 370GT (V36) , Nissan Fairlady Z / Fairlady Z Version Nismo (Z34) , and Infiniti G37 GT/S/S Premium (V36) and Q60 3.7 (V36) . Please confirm your vehicle is fitted with Akebono rear calipers before ordering — vehicles with standard non-Akebono calipers require a different rotor.
